headline: Approved three staff appointments, including an interim assistant principal for Westbrook Middle School and an occupational therapist for Saccarappa School.
summary: John Adams will serve as interim assistant principal at Westbrook Middle School for the rest of the 26 27 School Year. Eric Campbell was approved for a one-year assistant special services director job, and Bridget Lynch for an occupational therapist job at Saccarappa School.

transcript:
# MINUTES OF MEETING

**Westbrook School Committee**, September 24, 2026

1. Call to Order - Chair Andrea Mancuso called the meeting to order; it was 5:30 pm.

2. Pledge of Allegiance

3. Roll Call - Allison, Brunette, Erin Cavallaro, Noreen Poitras Chair Andrea Mancuso, Superintendent Dr. Peter Lancia. , Brooke Reed, Dr. Flynn Ross, Vice-Chair Katy Rice and student representatives were absent. There was a quorum.

4. Land Acknowledgement Statement - Chair Andrea Mancuso read the Land Acknowledgement statement.

5. Adjustments to the Agenda -

Under New Business 8.1.2 Occupational Therapist / Saccarappa School

**MOTION** Ms. Cavallaro moved and Mrs. Poitras seconded the motion to add 8.1.3 Occupational Therapist / Saccarappa School as presented

**Vote:** 4 in favor - 0 opposed

6. Public Participation - There was no Public Participation

7. Old Business - There was no Old Business

## 8. New Business

### 8.1 Teacher / Administrator Nominations

#### 8.1.1 Interim Assistant Principal for the remainder of the 26 27 School Year / Westbrook Middle School

John Adams is nominated for this interim position for the remainder of the 2026 - 2027 school year. He will be replacing Pattie DeMaria who took the Interim Principal position for the 26 27 school year. He will be paid $113,941; to be pro-rated based on a start date of September 25, 2026 (Account # 1000.0000.2400.51050.060.000000 Middle School Assist Principal Salary). This position was advertised within, on ServingSchools.com, K12JobSpot.com and the Westbrook School Department website; there were 14 applicants.

Mr. Adams has a Bachelor's degree in English and History from the University of North Carolina and a Master's degree in Educational Leadership from the New England College.

Mr. Adams retired in 2025 from a teaching position at Farmington High School, NH. He has six (6) years of administrative experience.

#### 8.1.2 Assistant Special Services Director (One Year Only)

Eric Campbell is nominated for this one year only position. He will be paid $115,903 and $3,000 for a CAS which will be pro-rated based on his actual start date in this position (Account # 1000.2500.2330.51050.900.000000 Sp. Ed. Asst Special Education Director). This position was advertised within, on ServingSchools.com, K12JobSpot.com and the Westbrook School Department website; there were 13 applicants.

Mr. Campbell has a Bachelor's degree in History from Saint Anselm College, NH and a Master's degree in Special Education from the University of Maine.

Mr. Campbell is employed as Vice President of Educational Services for Spurwink Services.

#### ADDED 8.1.3 Occupational Therapist / Saccarappa School

Bridget Lynch is nominated for this position replacing Emily Bisson who resigned. She will be placed on Level C (3 years of experience) of the Master's / Bachelor's +30 scale $61,108 for the 2026 - 2027 school year. (Account # 1000.2800.2160.51010.040.000000 Sp. Ed. OT Salary). This position was advertised within, on ServingSchools.com, K12JobSpot.com and the Westbrook School Department website; there were 5 applicants.

Ms. Lynch has a Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration and Public Health and a Master's degree in Occupational Therapy from Husson College.

Ms. Lynch was employed as a Pediatric Occupational Therapist at Saco Bay Kids, Saco, ME.

**MOTION** Mrs. Poitras moved and Ms. Brunette seconded the motion to approve 8.1.1 Interim Assistant Principal for the remainder of the 26 27 School Year / Westbrook Middle School and Assistant Special Services Director (One Year Only) and 8.1.3 Occupational Therapist / Saccarappa School as presented

**Vote:** 4 in favor - 0 opposed

Chair Andrea Mancuso thanked the School Committee members who served on the interview committees.

9. Important Dates

- Oct 7, 5:00 PM - Finance Committee Meeting - Central Office
- Oct 9 - No School - Professional Development Day
- Oct 12 - No School - Indigenous Peoples' Day
- Oct 14, 5:00 PM - Educational Programs Committee Meeting - Central Office
- Oct 14, 7:00 PM - School Committee Meeting - Rm 114, High School
- Oct 21, 5:00 PM - Facilities Committee Meeting - High School
- Oct 28, 5:00 PM - Policy Committee Meeting - Central Office

10. Announcements - There were no announcements

11. Adjournment - Action Item - Approval

**MOTION** Ms. Cavallaro moved and Mrs. Poitras seconded the motion to adjourn

**Vote:** 4 in favor - 0 opposed

Andrea Mancuso, Chair

Peter Lancia, Ph. D., Secretary
